The minimal scientific core is therefore one adaptive decision-sufficient contact operator feeding constrained normal-tangential impedance selection; A and B remain preserved implementation branches rather than independent active Principles.

predictions.observable: Incremental held-out impedance regret and viable-set prediction from nested histories
predictions.pattern_a: Retained history changes the certified feasible set or joint outcome, and a smaller state matches the full state within tolerance.
predictions.pattern_b: Richer history adds no reproducible set or decision value.
predictions.killer_criterion: No retained information family adds decision or outcome value.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Offline certificate replay and nested-state ablation.

predictions.observable: Matched history-conditioned versus memoryless certificate-capacity relations on the same supported episode-action population: one-sided certificate-margin coverage, set conservatism, nonempty certified-action rate and induced robust impedance outcome
predictions.pattern_a: The history-conditioned relation meets the predeclared coverage target and, relative to the memoryless relation constrained to that same target, exceeds the predeclared non-equivalence threshold in sharpness, certified-action retention or induced robust outcome; unsupported pairs are separately caught before outcomes and use the internal envelope-conservative certified set.
predictions.pattern_b: The memoryless relation also meets the same coverage target and is equivalent to the history-conditioned relation within the predeclared tolerances for conservatism, certified-action retention and induced robust outcome.
predictions.activation_condition: Capacity-affecting material, geometry, sliding or contact-history aliases occur inside the declared population.
predictions.killer_criterion: Pattern B kills the history-conditioned capacity delta; failure of the history-conditioned relation to meet coverage or to keep unsupported in-envelope pairs inside a nonempty conservative certified set kills A-COVERAGE-B.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: One paired held-out replay can decide both calibrated validity and whether retained history adds certificate/decision value before online controller trials.

predictions.observable: Nonemptiness, conservatism, feasibility and latency of the certified action set under forced interruption
predictions.pattern_a: A certified backup exists and is returned at every deadline while optimized actions improve joint cost inside the same set.
predictions.pattern_b: The certificate is empty/vacuous or too conservative where an incumbent horizon policy remains feasible and performant.
predictions.activation_condition: Cold starts and active physical margins.
predictions.killer_criterion: Any declared context lacks a timely certified action or the certificate destroys the required joint performance envelope.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Reachability/barrier feasibility maps and interruption sweeps distinguish this mechanism before physical trials.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Preserved exactly as a reviewed R5 branch and design evidence, but merged into R6 as an internal real-time feasibility renderer. Its incumbent or viability mechanism does not itself update the contact relation under calibration-out material, geometry, sliding or history changes, so it is not retained as an independent core scientific Principle.

candidate_principles.principle: Represent continuous soft contact by the smallest recursively updated action-conditional predictive operator that preserves constrained normal-tangential impedance feasibility and ranking; adapt that operator from closed-loop innovations and acquire information only through impedance actions already admissible under the same constraints; then select and render impedance through one deadline-total constrained relation.
activation_conditions: A material, local geometry, sliding condition, speed, dwell or loading-history change inside the declared physical envelope changes the predicted contact margin or preferred feasible impedance.
Posterior disagreement or normalized innovation is large enough to alter feasibility or cost ordering, and an informative action remains admissible.
candidate_principles.intervention: Encode the observed action-wrench-motion history into a predictive state z_k; map z_k and candidate gain sequence a=(k_n,d_n,k_t,d_t) to a posterior over future force error, tangential tracking error, slip/contact-loss margins, wrench, interaction energy and actuator load; update a low-dimensional adaptive readout after every observation using forgetting Bayesian recursive least squares with innovation-triggered covariance inflation; include a bounded one-step information-gain term only when uncertainty changes the optimizer's decision; and solve a robust or chance-constrained receding-horizon gain problem whose verified feasible incumbent is the deadline output.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: the NNBO chain of preidentified scalar fixed-parameter environment model followed by unconstrained optimal impedance becomes one online-adaptive, action-conditional contact-to-constrained-impedance relation
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The predictive operator separates histories only when they imply different gain feasibility or outcomes, while recursive posterior adaptation and admissible information acquisition repair in-envelope calibration-out changes. Applying all hard limits to the same gain variables and returning only a verified member repairs selection-rendering decoupling without elevating the renderer into the scientific headline.
failure_conditions: The observation history does not distinguish decision-relevant contact aliases before a gain change is needed.
No admissible impedance variation provides enough excitation to track the changing operator.
Posterior uncertainty sets are miscalibrated or exclude the realized margin process.
The low-dimensional contact-frame gain class cannot achieve the required joint performance.
No feasible incumbent exists or its verification exceeds the update deadline.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A compact action-observation history state predicts every future margin needed to preserve impedance feasibility and ranking over the declared action class.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The representation must expand or the claim envelope must narrow; otherwise the optimizer acts on aliased contact states.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: In-envelope calibration-out changes are locally learnable from naturally occurring or constraint-feasible informative impedance variation faster than they invalidate the decision.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The method may detect uncertainty but cannot claim recovery of useful optimal adaptation.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: The posterior plus population-scoped calibration produces conservative enough one-sided margins for the optimizer-consumed outcomes.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Constraint semantics and robust gain selection are invalid.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A verified admissible gain or fallback exists at initialization and can be updated or returned within every declared deadline.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The applied-action relation is not total in the claimed envelope.

target_domain_operationalization: Use the instantaneous contact frame and a minimal four-parameter scan impedance a_k=(k_n,d_n,k_t,d_t); orthogonal tangential and rotational gains remain fixed within declared bounds unless evidence shows their variation changes the decision.

Let y_k contain pose/indentation and velocity, six-axis wrench, scan tangent/normal, slip/contact indicators, previous gain, and interaction-energy ledger; z_k=E(y_{0:k},a_{0:k-1}) is a predictive rather than material-identification state.

The operator predicts an H-step distribution of force and tangent tracking errors plus one-sided margins for contact retention, friction/slip, wrench, energy and actuator limits conditional on the candidate gain sequence.

Offline learning uses multistep predictive likelihood plus decision distortion: feasible-set disagreement and downstream constrained cost regret relative to a higher-information teacher. Nested-state pruning removes features without held-out decision value.

Online learning freezes the representation backbone and recursively adapts a low-dimensional outcome readout and covariance. Persistent innovation increases forgetting and covariance; subsequent data changes both predicted mean and uncertainty, so in-envelope shift handling is adaptation, not unsupported rejection.

If uncertainty is decision-relevant, the same constrained optimizer values an admissible gain perturbation by expected reduction of active-margin and cost uncertainty. If no informative admissible action exists, it keeps the safest feasible action and records that optimality recovery is unavailable.

The horizon optimizer minimizes expected force-regulation and tangential-tracking loss plus contact-loss/slip risk, gain variation and decision-gated information cost, subject to posterior robust or chance constraints on force/torque, contact/friction, interaction energy, actuator limits and gain magnitude/rate.

An RTI-SQP implementation warm-starts from the shifted previously verified gain sequence. A candidate iterate replaces the incumbent only after the same posterior-margin verification; timeout returns the incumbent. Barrier/viability is an optional alternative renderer only if a useful nonempty certificate can later be justified.
Outside the declared physical envelope the method stops or transitions to an external system-level emergency policy; no arbitrary-shift adaptation or coverage claim is made.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: NNBO identifies a scalar Hunt-Crossley model before interaction and leaves abrupt or time-varying parameters for future work; MPVIC learns a probabilistic Cartesian model and plans stiffness but is offline or fine-tuned, unconstrained and not a continuous finite-area soft-contact adaptation method; uncertainty-tightened MPC does not select coupled impedance under history shift.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: A predictive contact operator is defined by constrained impedance decisions, recursively adapted under shift, and coupled to admissible information acquisition and the same constrained gain optimizer.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Tests whether decision-sufficient online contact adaptation, rather than more complete material reconstruction or a safety renderer as headline, enables useful constrained normal-tangential optimal impedance across declared calibration-out changes.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: An online-adaptive predictive contact operator that changes only when constrained impedance decisions change, with decision-relevant uncertainty reduced through feasible impedance actions and consumed directly by a deadline-total normal-tangential optimizer.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Relative to NNBO, the contact object changes from fixed scalar material parameters to a history- and action-conditioned posterior over joint contact outcomes; identification moves from a preliminary phase to continuous recursive adaptation; and scalar unconstrained optimal control becomes constrained belief-space receding-horizon selection of normal and tangential stiffness/damping. Relative to A/B, feasibility rendering remains necessary but is subordinate to the adaptive contact-to-decision mechanism.

predictions.observable: Matched-compute held-out feasible-set agreement and impedance regret for scalar NNBO state, full physical features and the proposed predictive state
predictions.pattern_a: The predictive state matches the high-information teacher within tolerance while scalar NNBO aliases histories and full reconstruction adds no decision value.
predictions.pattern_b: A calibrated memoryless or scalar contact state is decision-equivalent on the same shifts and margins.
predictions.activation_condition: Held-out material, geometry, sliding or loading-history aliases occur.
predictions.killer_criterion: No reproducible downstream decision advantage over the calibrated memoryless rival kills the representation delta.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Paired offline replay of identical histories and action probes isolates representation value before controller trials.

predictions.observable: After an in-envelope abrupt or gradual shift, time to recover calibrated margin prediction and constrained impedance regret under passive update versus decision-gated feasible excitation
predictions.pattern_a: Recursive updates change the posterior mean/covariance and feasible gains, and feasible information actions shorten recovery without extra violations.
predictions.pattern_b: Only unsupported detection occurs, or useful recovery requires inadmissible excitation or per-condition retraining, leaving a conservative fixed action as the only reliable response.
predictions.activation_condition: The shift changes active contact margins and at least one informative admissible action exists.
predictions.killer_criterion: Failure to recover decision quality inside the declared adaptation horizon, despite admissible excitation, kills the active OOC-handling claim.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: A logged model-in-the-loop shift replay can compare posterior and decisions before physical scanning.

predictions.observable: Membership of every rendered gain in the optimizer-defined hard-margin set under forced interruption, infeasibility and uncertainty inflation
predictions.pattern_a: Every deadline returns the verified incumbent from the same feasible relation; only achieved cost degrades with less compute.
predictions.pattern_b: The nominal gain is later projected, overridden, or absent at a deadline, so selected and applied actions diverge.
predictions.activation_condition: A physical, uncertainty or computation margin becomes active.
predictions.killer_criterion: Any in-envelope update without a timely admissible output kills the total-relation claim.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Solver interruption and constraint-activation replay directly audits the relation without asserting final performance.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: This is the minimal R6 re-anchoring that directly repairs both accepted RMCs and the user's calibration-out requirement. It retains R5 A/B mechanisms only in the roles evidence supports: incumbent as the chosen real-time renderer, viability as an optional alternative, conformal calibration as population-scoped uncertainty calibration, and robust optimization as constraint semantics.

paper_level_methodology.working_title: Adaptive Decision-Sufficient Contact Operators for Constrained Normal-Tangential Impedance Control
paper_level_methodology.central_relation: (history, candidate impedance) -> adaptive posterior over contact outcomes and hard margins -> one constrained impedance decision
paper_level_methodology.online_update: For frozen nonlinear features phi(z_k,a_k), use mu_k=W_k phi and Sigma_k=Sigma_noise+phi^T P_k phi. A forgetting Bayesian/RLS update changes W_k and P_k after each observed outcome; a sustained normalized innovation inflates P_k and lowers the forgetting factor. This is a concrete local adaptation choice because a full-network online update would be too slow and difficult to bound, while fixed features retain learned cross-condition structure.
paper_level_methodology.decision_objective: Over a short horizon, minimize expected weighted force and tangential trajectory error, CVaR or upper confidence bounds for slip/contact loss, and gain variation; subtract bounded expected information gain only where posterior sensitivity shows that uncertainty can change an active constraint or gain ranking.
paper_level_methodology.constraint_relation: The same gain sequence must satisfy posterior one-sided limits for force/torque, contact retention and friction, interaction-energy ledger, actuator effort, gain bounds/rates and terminal incumbent feasibility. Population conformal residuals may calibrate initial scale on declared exchangeable episodes but are not claimed to guarantee post-shift adaptation.
analysis_scope: Decision-equivalence proposition: operator-equivalent histories induce the same robust feasible set and gain ranking up to the declared distortion tolerance.

Conditional adaptation result: under bounded drift and persistent admissible excitation, local posterior error remains bounded; the exact rate and constants remain to be derived, not assumed achieved.
Conditional totality proposition: with a feasible initial incumbent, conservative posterior margins and within-budget verification, interruption changes cost but not existence of the applied action.
baseline_delta: NNBO scalar fixed Hunt-Crossley parameters -> history-conditioned posterior over normal-tangential wrench, slip/contact and energy-relevant outcomes.
NNBO pre-identification -> continuous local posterior update with decision-gated feasible information acquisition.
NNBO one-dimensional unconstrained HJB/critic relation -> short-horizon constrained optimization of normal/tangential stiffness and damping.
NNBO conditional model/critic analysis without physical hard limits -> optimizer-consumed wrench, energy, actuator, gain-rate and deadline semantics.

source_mechanism_migrations.target_adaptation: Core tests become short impedance probes and their predicted outcomes are wrench, slip/contact and task margins; recursive spectral guarantees are not transferred as contact guarantees.

source_mechanism_migrations.migrated_mechanism: Retain and train model information according to downstream value or decision regret.
source_mechanism_migrations.target_adaptation: Distortion is feasible-set mismatch plus constrained impedance regret rather than Bellman error or linear-program cost.
source_mechanism_migrations.actual_role: Makes the contact operator decision-sufficient rather than a larger digital twin.

source_mechanism_migrations.migrated_mechanism: Probabilistic dynamics uncertainty and information-seeking actions coupled to MPC impedance choice.
source_mechanism_migrations.target_adaptation: Move from offline free-space stiffness planning to continuous contact readout adaptation, decision-gated safe excitation, normal-tangential gains and hard margins.
source_mechanism_migrations.actual_role: Supplies the partial model-uncertainty-action loop, not the full Target method.

source_mechanism_migrations.migrated_mechanism: Finite-area viscoelastic history changes normal force, tangential capacity and moment limits.
source_mechanism_migrations.target_adaptation: Use those as outcome families the predictive operator must preserve when decision-relevant, rather than fitting the paper's complete constitutive law online.

source_mechanism_migrations.migrated_mechanism: Split residual calibration and warm-started feasibility-oriented optimization.
source_mechanism_migrations.target_adaptation: Calibration is limited to initial one-sided scale on a declared population; verified-incumbent retention is added as an internal deadline renderer. Neither Source is credited with OOC adaptation or full totality.

contributions.contribution: A decision-sufficient soft-contact operator whose state and outputs are defined by the constrained normal-tangential impedance decisions they preserve, replacing NNBO's fixed scalar environment parameters without requiring universal material reconstruction.
contributions.why_it_matters: It retains finite-area, tangential and history information exactly where the accepted RCA says scalar/contact-fixed models alias different decisions.
contributions.migration_account: PSR supplies observable predictive state; VES/SPO supply downstream decision sufficiency; both are adapted to contact-margin and impedance-feasible-set objects.

contributions.contribution: A concrete in-envelope calibration-out adaptation mechanism that recursively changes the contact posterior and, only when decision-relevant, selects constraint-feasible informative impedance variation.
contributions.why_it_matters: It addresses new materials, geometry, sliding and loading history by learning during the scan rather than merely flagging unsupported input or freezing to a conservative policy.
contributions.migration_account: MPVIC's probabilistic model and information-seeking loop are moved into continuous soft contact and bounded by the same physical constraints; no zero-shot or arbitrary-shift claim is made.

contributions.contribution: A unified constrained receding-horizon relation that turns the adaptive posterior into time-varying normal and tangential stiffness/damping while enforcing wrench, contact, interaction-energy, actuator, gain-rate and deadline requirements on the actually rendered action.
contributions.why_it_matters: The optimizer must change with the representation: posterior action-conditioned outcome distributions cannot be consumed by NNBO's scalar unconstrained optimal relation.
contributions.migration_account: Robust/calibrated margins and feasible-incumbent computation are used as internal semantics; A/B are preserved but demoted from competing scientific headlines.

key_technical_risks: Safe excitation may be too weak for adaptation before the contact regime changes again.
Frozen features may not span truly novel deformation or friction regimes, making last-layer adaptation biased.
Posterior calibration under dependent closed-loop trajectories is harder than exchangeable offline calibration.
Joint uncertainty propagation and hard-margin verification may exceed the scan update budget.
The four-gain contact-frame action class may be too restrictive, while a richer matrix impedance may destroy identifiability and real-time feasibility.
